_comment: Cash Signal country record. Every indicator is a 'datum': {value, available, as_of, source_ids, note}. available is one of 'yes' | 'partial' | 'no'. value is null when available=='no'. source_ids reference ids in sources[]. Keep notes to one line.
name: Afghanistan
calp_region: Asia-Pacific | MENA | East and Southern Africa | West and Central Africa

plan.name: Afghanistan Humanitarian Needs and Response Plan 2026
plan.type: HNRP | HRP | Flash Appeal | RRP | Other | None
plan.status: published | draft | not yet published | none

plan_2027.status: not yet published | in preparation | published | unknown

modality_preference._comment: Share of surveyed population preferring each modality. Record the survey, year and sample in note/as_of. Percentages 0-100.
modality_preference.survey_note: e.g. REACH MSNA 2025, n=12,000 HH, question wording

cost_efficiency._comment: Record the metric exactly as the source states it. unit examples: 'cost-transfer ratio', 'USD per USD delivered', 'USD per beneficiary', 'Omega value'. Do not convert.

hnrp_requirements._comment: Share of the plan's total financial requirements. Percentages 0-100. Also give the USD figure in usd where known.

overall_funding._comment: Share of funding received against the plan (FTS) that is MPC / sectoral cash / vouchers. Usually only MPC is visible in FTS as a sector; say so in note if sectoral cash and vouchers are not disaggregated.

mpc_funded_pct_of_mpc_req.note: MPC funding received as % of MPC requirement

pooled_funds._comment: Country-based pooled fund (CBPF) and CERF. Share of allocations that is MPC / sectoral cash / vouchers.

market_monitoring.system: e.g. REACH JMMI; WFP market monitor; CWG price monitoring

cwg.evidence_note: one line on activity level: e.g. monthly meetings, published MEB 2025, 4W dashboard

ai_summary.headline: One sentence, <= 20 words, the single most important thing about cash in this response.
ai_summary.narrative: 120-180 words. Evidence first, inference labelled. Cite source ids inline like [s1].
data_gaps: which Excel indicators could not be found, one phrase each

rep_notes._comment: For CALP regional representatives. Leave all empty.
